source_assessment.web_retry: offline-sync.js computes an individual draft's nextAttemptAtMs from Retry-After, persists it through JagaOfflineStore.update, skips only rows whose deadline is still in the future, and continues after a 429. The 15-second periodic sync and online event retry later. Valid Retry-After 1 remains 1000 ms; malformed, zero, or absent values use the native-compatible 60000 ms fallback; values above 86400 seconds are capped at 24 hours.
source_assessment.durability_and_account_scope: offline-store.js stores draft rows in IndexedDB with accountId and account-qualified keys. pendingForSync queries the accountId index, filters pending status, and rechecks ownership after the asynchronous transaction. Updates read/merge/write the existing row in a readwrite transaction and check ownership before and after. The retry deadline is a regular persisted row field; no volatile global retry gate is present.
source_assessment.account_switch_guards: offline-sync.js snapshots generation/account per run and checks both before each draft, after the health check before upload, after a successful response before state update, and on errors before deadline/error updates. start/stop advance generation. Store ownership checks reject reads/writes after lock or account change. Focused Node tests confirm account B's draft proceeds while account A's draft is deferred; browser tests confirm store isolation and lock behavior.
source_assessment.cache_revision_change: Current frontend/app.js retains only jk-v9 during cache cleanup; frontend/sw.js declares jk-v9 and its shell references offline-sync.js?v=14; frontend/index.html loads offline-sync.js?v=14. These are cache/shell revision changes only and do not alter retry logic. Source hashes record the final inspected versions.
